*PharmaCraft Daily - 08 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Autonomic Nervous System)
Q: Atropine acts by blocking which receptor?
Ans: Muscarinic
Why: Atropine is a competitive muscarinic antagonist, causing tachycardia, mydriasis and dry secretions.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Drug of choice for status epilepticus (first-line IV)?
Ans: Lorazepam
Why: IV benzodiazepine (lorazepam) is first-line; phenytoin, valproate or levetiracetam are second-line.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Cardiovascular)
Q: Vericiguat used in heart failure is a?
Ans: Soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator
Why: Vericiguat stimulates soluble guanylate cyclase, raising cGMP, and reduces HF events in worsening chronic HFrEF.

🌍 *FMGE* (Cardiovascular)
Q: Which drug is used to treat hypertensive emergency IV?
Ans: Sodium nitroprusside
Why: Sodium nitroprusside is a rapid IV vasodilator for hypertensive emergency; prolonged use risks cyanide toxicity.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Clinical Trials)
Q: Intention-to-treat analysis means patients are analysed?
Ans: By the group they were randomised to
Why: Intention-to-treat analyses all randomised patients in their original group, preserving randomisation and reducing bias.
